title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves! — Episode3 The Miya Girls School Festival Starts Now!

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Episode: Episode3 — The Miya Girls School Festival Starts Now!
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Line: A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's see... The classroom with the copy machine should be this one.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We won't really know how it looks until we print it... But I have a good feeling about this design!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Shiho and Minori's teams also look like they're almost done with their tasks... I'm really looking forward to seeing how everything turns out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Huh? Over there... That looks like Emu and...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Our flyer turned our super duper cute, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it did.
All that's left for us is to not make any mistakes during our performance...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We'll be fine!
So, let's do our best as the little piggies!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Little piggies...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right. Class B is putting on a play. Does that mean Emu and Honami are going to be pigs?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wait, that's Airi and Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly, how'd you end up with the key to the chemistry lab? Didn't I tell you to go ask for the key to the home ec room...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Airi. I know this is going to make baking anything rather difficult, but the lab does have these Bunsen burners... Can't we use those somehow?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're supposed to be baking, not brewing up mad concoctions...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, Hinomori, Momoi, hello. What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Asahina!
The thing is, we wanted to borrow the key to the home ec room but ended up with the key to the chemistry lab...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Ah, that may be because I currently have the key you're looking for. Why don't we head there together? I was thinking about hiding something there for the treasure hunt.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really?! Thanks, Asahina!
You're a lifesaver!

Wow! Penguins!!
So many adorable penguins!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our animal cafe's gonna look sooo cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's going to turn into a penguin cafe at this rate if we're not careful. Did you two bring any animal-related goods that we can use?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I bought some animal ear headbands after Saki suggested that we should. I'm a little embarrassed about wearing one, but shall we try them on together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow... Every class is really trying their best. I guess this just means we all want the School Festival to go well...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Alright...
I need to keep doing my best too...!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy School Festival - Day 1

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is it...!
B-But I feel kind of nervous.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Morning, Kohane!
This is it! The School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, Shiho! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make sure all of our guests have fun today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, our “guests” today are all going to be Miya Girls students since we don't open to the general public until tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But students count as real guests!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you're not wrong.
In any case, we're gonna send shivers down their spines.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, right. You two are supposed to be wolves today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! My shift starts in the afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's do our best, Shiho!
We gotta roar like we mean it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Roar? We're supposed to be wolves, not lions... But point taken. Let's do our best to really scare them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Good luck.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, while we're on the subject...
What are you two doing before your shifts start?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I haven't decided...
Why don't we take this opportunity to go around and take a look at what everyone's doing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wait, are you sure?
I thought you were going to hang out with Ichika and the others...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, we should be good for today. They all said they're gonna be busy for a while, and we aren't performing until the night festival.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
Then, let's go see what's happening!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Announcement
rows.Line: “The first day of the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy School Festival will now...commence!”
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we absolutely need to stop here first!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hello!
Welcome to the Flufftacular Animal Cafe☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: W-Welcome...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh wow..!
They filled their entire classroom with animal plushies!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait... It's you guys!
Thanks for dropping by♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was wondering what your class was doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Your cafe's very...cute...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Isn't it though♪
We're gonna wait tables while wearing these animal ear headbands♪ I get to be a bunny, and Ichi gets to be a dog with droopy ears!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait...!
Does that mean Haruka's also wearing one...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, thanks for coming.
Welcome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Haru...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Haruka's wearing cat ears!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh no... What do I do...?
A cat... On Haruka's ears... A kitty cat...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, don't you mean cat ears on her...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. How do I look...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Y-Y-You look waaay too cute, Haruka! So cute that my head might pop off!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Your head...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, let me show you to your seats, and please enjoy your visit.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for your patience. Here's your Hamster Cheek Pudding, Fluffy Bunny Tail Mousse and Soft & Squishy Doggy Cream Puff.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
This is so cute! I almost wish that I didn't have to eat it...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
...!
It's so fluffy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm glad you like them so much.
I was a little worried since I didn't have much time to practice making them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?! H-Haruka, you made these?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Not from scratch if that's what you mean... The individual pieces of these desserts are store-bought. I just tried putting them together in a cute way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I see...
B-But I get to have a dessert that you put together, Haruka. How is this not the best cafe ever...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I, Minori Hanasato, promise to give a review that does this masterpiece justice!
AV Room

rows.Speaker: Third Kobuta Sister
rows.Line:
“Serves you right, Mr. Okami!
Not even you can knock down the Kobuta family's superalloy house!”

rows.Speaker: Mr. Okami
rows.Line:
“No! My precious crane...
It couldn't knock down your superalloy house...”

rows.Speaker: Third Kobuta Sister
rows.Line: “Now, Mr. Okami, it's time for us to take you to the police!”

rows.Speaker: Eldest Kobuta Sister
rows.Line: “What you've done is terrible. Knocking down all those houses... You need to pay for your crimes.”

rows.Speaker: Eldest Kobuta Sister
rows.Line: “Willful destruction of property does come with a five-year sentence, but you'll be free once again after you've repaid your debt to society.”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami's actually pretty good at acting.
But this story's kind of nuts...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was wondering what they meant by “The Real Three Little Pigs”... Do you think someone from their class wrote the script?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I vaguely remember hearing that Honami asked Tsukasa and the others for some tips...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That'd explain a lot if Tsukasa was the one who came up with this. I mean, so many things feel off about this story...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's so sad...!
Mr. Okami was only knocking down the Kobuta sisters' houses because he didn't have a place to call home...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I guess it hits some people pretty hard...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Looks like it.
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmmm...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't figure out the last riddle of this treasure hunt... Do you know what it's talking about, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... “Ye shall find the last treasure in a place that is always visible, but is not always seen.” Where is this “place” it's talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Somewhere that's always visible, but not always seen...? Hmm... Do we just need to keep looking for clues?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I don't think we have time.
I'm guessing we only have about a minute left...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Time's up, treasure hunters!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! No!
Already?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-We spent all of our time just thinking...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Thank you all for participating.
As a consolation prize, you each receive a homemade quiz booklet. I hope you enjoy them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Oh, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Do you think Asahina was the one who came up with those riddles? They were really hard, but also really fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, they were.
But that last one's still really bugging me...
Oh, Shii, over here♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh oh... That voice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku and Airi are inside that stall!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Welcome, you three.
Out for a stroll together?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes!
We just tried our luck with the treasure hunt.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nice.
Sounds like your brains had to do a little overtime.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, how would you like to try some of Class 2-D's homemade sweets?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Woohoo! What kind of sweets do you...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-These look like pot stickers!
And this one looks like ramen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, those aren't sweets...
Hang on. Does this mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Correct! They're lookalike sweets!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I just noticed that these pot stickers are cookies...! And this ramen's...pound cake...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. We baked these with our classmates. They look pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi came up with the recipes for these and even taught everyone how to bake them. It was like she was the teacher.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, take your pick!
We've even got some over here that look just like takoyaki.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
Okay, I'd like... One of those pot sticker cookies!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, then... I think I'll have one of those takoyaki cream puffs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And you'll have the ramen, right, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Slow down. I mean, yeah, it looks like ramen... But it's not...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Is it that you don't like these kinds of sweets very much...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, geez...
Okay, okay, I'll have one.
Momoi, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for your purchase!
We'll have them right out in a second!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
They were good, but it tasted so different to what it looked like...
My mind was having trouble comprehending what I was eating.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. That made eating them all the more fun!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We went to the animal cafe, saw a play, tried solving some riddles, had some sweets... And it's not even noon yet! We've done so much already!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I hate to rain on your parade, but we still have work to do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do our best to make our haunted house as cute, scary and fun as possible!

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Make sure to stop by Class 1-A!
We're doing a haunted house called “Little Red Riding Hood and the Young Goats' Slightly Scary Forest Adventure”!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't have to be a thrill seeker! It's meant to be fun for everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: So, it's a haunted house that's not too scary? Can you tell us more?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you can choose to make it a game by becoming a hunter with a gun who can chase away the wolves...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Before you enter, you can choose that or enjoy it as a normal haunted house! Wh-What do you think...?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds fun...!
Wanna check it out? I kinda want to see what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...!
I hope you all enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane.
Are you on advertising duty right now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Haruka!
Shouldn't you be at your cafe?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My shift just ended, so we decided to have a look around.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Oh, you're all here! Please enjoy!
Inside the Haunted House

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
*Howl*
I'm gonna gobble you up!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no! A wolf!
Wait, it's eyes are so big... That's so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, it is.
But don't forget that you're the hunter, Saki. You have to shoot any wolves you see.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I forgot!
Bang! Bang!

rows.Speaker: Mischievous Wolf
rows.Line:
*Squeal*
Oof...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You just took out the Big Bad Minori.

rows.Speaker: Cool Wolf
rows.Line: *Howl*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh oh... This one sounds like it means business...!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
That was so much fun!
Wanna come again tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It wasn't that scary either! My little brother's gonna love this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, you two! Nice work!
Our guests seem to be really enjoying everything!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I noticed that too.
I saw a lot of people going through it multiple times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
That means our haunted house is a huge success♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This also means An and the others should be able to enjoy it when they all come to visit tomorrow...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really hope they like what we made!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori, there you all are!
We have an emergency!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? What's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: One of the girls who was scheduled to be a wolf tomorrow morning got sick and won't be able to make it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?! That's awful!
During the School Festival too. But she definitely should rest...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't that mean someone else is gonna need to fill in for her?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
About that...
We're having trouble finding a replacement because a lot of girls in our class have to do club stuff in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... What do we do...?
I can't really replace her since I'm already assigned to be a wolf in the morning...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have to run an equipment check in the morning for the night festival, so I won't be able to help either...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...
The morning...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An and the others said they'd be visiting in the afternoon. So, as long as I still get to meet up with them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... What if I replaced her?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, Kohane, are you sure?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've already made plans for the afternoon, but I should be free in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Thanks, Azusawa!
You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Scaring people won't be easy for me...
But I want our guests to have fun and enjoy themselves.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I'm gonna do my best as a wolf tomorrow!)

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
